definition.rmse_rootmean: per test day sqrt(mean_h (mean of the 200 samples - observed)^2), kWh; summarized over the 92 test days (the Fig. 4 scale; spec section 3)
definition.rmse_euclid: per test day ||mean of the 200 samples - observed||_2 over the 48 half-hours (eq. 12 literally)
definition.sample_sd: SD across the 200 samples, averaged over days and half-hours (kWh)
definition.active_units: latent dims with Var_days(posterior mean) > 0.01 on the training days (Burda et al. 2016)
definition.effects: lib.effects.scenario_effects (day-bootstrap 95% CIs, B=2000, seed 1000+c); pct of the Normal scenario over the same slots and days

matched_cluster_to_authors_3.relabel_rule: Hungarian on raw cluster-mean correlations (agrees with deviation and contingency matching)

fig6_day1.definition: per test day: 100 x (scenario - Normal) / Normal of the 200-sample means, averaged over the region's slots; day1 = 2013-01-01 (the day of the Fig. 6 replica); quantiles and sign over the 92 test days
